model_card.name: Flood loss cost model: Hybrid GLM fxs + county
model_card.structure: frequency GLM (Poisson, log link, exposure offset) x severity GLM (Gamma, log link) x large-loss load x ICC bridge x off-balance x Buhlmann-Straub county factor

validation.yardstick: re-based Tweedie (p = 1.5) deviance improvement vs no-features model; each unseen year once

model_card.why_not_xgboost: XGBoost is more accurate on unseen years (see reports/08_model_comparison.md) but has no relativity table; revisit after SHAP (Milestone 12).

disclaimer: Area-level estimate from aggregated public NFIP data (Virginia, 2010-2025). It describes the average insured building with these characteristics in this county in an average year. It is NOT a quote, a premium, or a prediction for any individual property.
